Ruby Marina InboundAI

Small ecommerce SaaS (widget marketplace) testing Redwood hosted API for customer support bot. Self-serve signup in Feb; early discovery due to higher-than-expected response times for US users. Primary goal: replace canned FAQ flows with RL-style contextual replies while keeping latency under 400ms p95 for support flows.
Support-agent/chat for ecommerce — live chat widget on web + agent-assist. Targets: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 400ms for short assists. Throughput initial: 100-1,000 reqs/day, spiky during sales events.
Early POC via self-serve; using hosted_api with sample model 'small-chat-v1'. Generated ~2k requests over 2 weeks. Observed p95 latency 600-900ms in EU region for US testers; after switching some traffic to us-west1 p95 dropped to ~420ms. No formal contract yet.

Client library has 3000ms overall timeout; their frontend sets 1200ms leading to apparent 'timeouts' and retries.

Switch to nearest region (us-west1) for US traffic — demonstrated 20-35% p95 improvement in quick test
Increase frontend client timeout to 5s for streaming flows; use streaming to surface first token quickly
Trim prompt length: canonical prompt + last N messages rather than full thread; enforce server-side max prompt tokens
Enable response chunking/streaming and set shorter per-chunk timeouts to avoid whole-request failures
Use model variant with faster throughput for short-turn conversations (lower context window) and save larger models for long summaries
Instrument SDK with per-route tracing and send trace ids to Redwood support for deep analysis
